combo3.title: Future Fusion Nova: one card into Final Strike Dragon (going second)
combo3.description: One card, going second. Future Fusion Nova Fusion Summons Cyber End Dragon, the Final Strike Dragon with three LIGHT Machines that have 2100 or more ATK, all straight from the Deck. One of them has to be the card named Cyber Dragon; Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon can fill the other slots but never that one. Because every material is LIGHT, Final Strike Dragon pays 4000 LP to add Limiter Removal: 8000 ATK, up to three attacks, piercing damage. Nova's lock lets only the Fusion Monster attack, and if Nova leaves the field the Dragon is destroyed. Starting hand: Future Fusion Nova. Deck needs: Cyber Dragon plus two more 2100-ATK LIGHT Machines (Cyber Dragon or Luminous Mech Dragon), and Limiter Removal.

cards.name: Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon
Cyber End Dragon, the Final Strike Dragon

steps.text: Activate Future Fusion Nova from your hand. The Fusion Summon is part of the activation.
Cyber Dragon goes from your Deck to the GY as material. Nova needs this exact card.
Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon goes from your Deck to the GY as material. It's a LIGHT Machine with 2100 ATK.
A second Cyber Dragon goes from your Deck to the GY as material.
Fusion Summon Cyber End Dragon, the Final Strike Dragon (4000 ATK). For the rest of the turn you can only Special Summon Machines, and only this monster can attack.
Activate effect: Cyber End Dragon, the Final Strike Dragon was Fusion Summoned using only LIGHT monsters. Pay 4000 LP.
Add Limiter Removal from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Limiter Removal. Your Machines double their ATK until the end of the turn.
Limiter Removal goes to the GY.

Battle Phase: Cyber End Dragon, the Final Strike Dragon has 8000 ATK, more than its original 4000, so it can attack up to 3 times and deals piercing damage to Defense Position monsters. One direct hit is 8000. Limiter Removal destroys it in the End Phase, and Nova goes with it.

combo4.title: Luminous Mech Dragon clears the way for Future Fusion Nova (going second)
combo4.description: Two cards, going second, both from Magnificent Maestros. Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon summons itself onto your empty field and negates your opponent's best face-up monster for the turn, before you commit anything else. That forces the choice: they spend a negate on Luminous, or the monster that would have stopped Future Fusion Nova is switched off. Nova then makes Cyber End Dragon, the Final Strike Dragon from the Deck and Limiter Removal finishes. Order matters: Luminous needs an empty field, so it comes first. Starting hand: Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon and Future Fusion Nova. Deck needs: Cyber Dragon plus two more 2100-ATK LIGHT Machines, and Limiter Removal.

Activate Future Fusion Nova from your hand.
Cyber Dragon goes from your Deck to the GY as material. Nova needs this exact card.
A second Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon goes from your Deck to the GY as material.
A second Cyber Dragon goes from your Deck to the GY as material.
Fusion Summon Cyber End Dragon, the Final Strike Dragon (4000 ATK).
Activate effect: Cyber End Dragon, the Final Strike Dragon was Fusion Summoned using only LIGHT monsters. Pay 4000 LP.
Add Limiter Removal from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Limiter Removal. Your Machines double their ATK until the end of the turn.
Limiter Removal goes to the GY.

Battle Phase: Cyber End Dragon, the Final Strike Dragon attacks up to 3 times at 8000 ATK with piercing damage. Luminous Mech Dragon is 4200 too, but Nova only lets the Fusion Monster it summoned attack.

combo5.title: Cyber Dragon Core into four interruptions, with Luminous Mech Dragon as the extender (going first)
combo5.description: One card, going first. Cyber Dragon Core starts the usual Cyberdark Realm, Chimera and Clockwork Knight chain. Cyber Dragon Herz adds Cyber Dragon, which pays for Clockwork Night, and Power Bond banishes Core and that Cyber Dragon from the GY through Chimera's effect. Chimeratech Rampage Dragon then sends Cyber Dragon Nachster and Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon from the Deck. Cyber Dragon Nova revives Nachster (its name is Cyber Dragon in the GY), Nachster revives Luminous Mech Dragon (2100 ATK), and Luminous fuses itself with Nachster into Heosvarog the Mechanical Dawn. End board: Cyber Dragon Infinity, Therion "King" Regulus, Heosvarog the Mechanical Dawn and S:P Little Knight, with Cyberdark Realm in hand. Power Bond costs 2100 LP in the End Phase. Adapted from a community line in the Master Duel subreddit and rebuilt step by step from the printed card text. Starting hand: Cyber Dragon Core.

cards.name: Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon

steps.text: Normal Summon Cyber Dragon Core.
Activate effect: Cyber Dragon Core was Normal Summoned, to add Cyberdark Realm from your Deck.
Add Cyberdark Realm from your Deck to your hand. Cyberdark cards are "Cyber" cards too.
Activate Cyberdark Realm, to add Cyberdark Chimera from your Deck.
Add Cyberdark Chimera from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Cyberdark Realm's effect to Normal Summon a Cyberdark monster.
Normal Summon Cyberdark Chimera.
Cyber Dragon Core becomes Link Material. Its original ATK is 400.
Link Summon Clockwork Knight.
Activate effect: Clockwork Knight was Link Summoned, sending Cyberdark Realm to the GY, to add Clockwork Night.
Send Cyberdark Realm to the GY as the cost.
Add Clockwork Night from your Deck to your hand.
Activate effect: Cyberdark Chimera, discarding Clockwork Night, to add Power Bond.
Discard Clockwork Night.
Add Power Bond from your Deck to your hand.
Cyberdark Chimera becomes Link Material.
Clockwork Knight becomes Link Material.
Link Summon S:P Little Knight.
Activate effect: Cyberdark Chimera was sent to the GY, to send Cyberdark Wurm from your Deck to the GY.
Cyberdark Chimera's effect sends Cyberdark Wurm from your Deck to the GY.
Activate effect: Cyberdark Wurm in your GY, sending Cyber Dragon Herz from your Deck to the GY.
Send Cyber Dragon Herz from your Deck to the GY as the cost.
Special Summon Cyberdark Wurm from your GY.
Add Cyberdark Realm from your GY to your hand.
Activate effect: Cyber Dragon Herz was sent to the GY, to add Cyber Dragon from your Deck.
Add Cyber Dragon from your Deck to your hand.
Activate effect: Clockwork Night in your GY, banishing it and discarding Cyber Dragon, to add Therion "King" Regulus.
Discard Cyber Dragon.
Add Therion "King" Regulus from your Deck to your hand.
Activate effect: Therion "King" Regulus in your hand, targeting Clockwork Knight in your GY.
Special Summon Therion "King" Regulus from your hand.
Clockwork Knight is equipped to Therion "King" Regulus.
Activate Power Bond.
Banish Cyber Dragon Core from your GY as material.
Banish Cyber Dragon from your GY as material.
Fusion Summon Chimeratech Rampage Dragon (4200 ATK with Power Bond).
Power Bond goes to the GY. Don't use Chimeratech Rampage Dragon's summon effect: the only Spells and Traps on the field are your own.
Activate effect: Chimeratech Rampage Dragon, to send Cyber Dragon Nachster and Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon from your Deck to the GY.
Chimeratech Rampage Dragon's effect sends Cyber Dragon Nachster from your Deck to the GY.
Chimeratech Rampage Dragon's effect sends Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon from your Deck to the GY.
Xyz Summon Cyber Dragon Nova.
Chimeratech Rampage Dragon becomes material for Cyber Dragon Nova.
Cyberdark Wurm becomes material for Cyber Dragon Nova.
Activate effect: Cyber Dragon Nova, detaching Cyberdark Wurm, to Special Summon Cyber Dragon Nachster from your GY.
Detach Cyberdark Wurm.
Special Summon Cyber Dragon Nachster from your GY.
Activate effect: Cyber Dragon Nachster was Special Summoned, targeting Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon in your GY.
Special Summon Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon from your GY.
Activate effect: Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon, to Fusion Summon Heosvarog the Mechanical Dawn using it and Cyber Dragon Nachster.
Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon goes to the GY as material.
Cyber Dragon Nachster goes to the GY as material.
Fusion Summon Heosvarog the Mechanical Dawn.
Activate effect: Heosvarog the Mechanical Dawn was Fusion Summoned. In the next Standby Phase, add a card that Fusion Summons from your GY.
Xyz Summon Cyber Dragon Infinity using Cyber Dragon Nova you control.
Cyber Dragon Nova becomes material for Cyber Dragon Infinity.
Chimeratech Rampage Dragon transfers along with Cyber Dragon Nova.

End board: Cyber Dragon Infinity (negate and destroy), Therion "King" Regulus (negate an effect), Heosvarog the Mechanical Dawn (negate a Spell/Trap by banishing 2 LIGHT Machines from your GY) and S:P Little Knight (banish 2 face-up monsters until the End Phase). Cyberdark Realm stays in your hand for next turn.
